cities.name: Sofia
interests: History & Orthodox Churches 🏛️ — Golden domes, medieval frescoes and traces of ancient Serdica below modern streets.
Urban Culture & Street Art 🎨 — Creative zones, cafés, murals and vibrant day-to-night local life.
Mountain Views & City Parks 🌳 — Vitosha Mountain panoramas, quiet paths and green relaxation areas.
cities.local_food_tip: Try banitsa, shopska salad, tarator, grilled meats and traditional pastries — classic Balkan comfort flavors. Top places include Moma, Hadjidraganov’s Houses and the cozy Made in Home.
cities.full_day: Morning: Begin at Alexander Nevsky Cathedral, admiring its gold-domed exterior and grand interior filled with icons and soft natural light. → Walk to the nearby St. Sophia Church, one of the city's oldest standing landmarks, sitting above archaeological layers. → Continue toward the central area and stop for coffee around the Opera House or National Assembly. Afternoon: Visit the National Archaeological Museum, housed in a former Ottoman mosque, where Thracian and Roman artifacts show Bulgaria’s early history. → Explore Vitosha Boulevard full of cafés, bakeries and mountain views at the far end. → Enjoy lunch at a traditional-style restaurant. Late Afternoon: Wander through the Serdica archaeological area near Serdika Station, where Roman ruins lie beside modern buildings. → Relax in Borisova Gradina, the city’s most beloved park. Sunset: Take a short taxi to a viewpoint below Vitosha Mountain for a golden-hour panorama. Night: Return to the center for dinner and a calm walk through lit streets, cafés and squares.

ideas: 🌸 Stroll under blooming trees in Borisova Gradina and surrounding parks.
📸 Great lighting conditions for photos of Alexander Nevsky Cathedral and Old Sofia streets.
☕ Outdoor cafés begin to fill along Vitosha Boulevard.
🌳 Picnics in Borisova Gradina or South Park.
🌅 Evenings along Vitosha Boulevard with street musicians and lively terraces.
⛰️ Cooler temperatures on Vitosha Mountain — ideal for short hikes.
🍁 Warm autumn tones along historical streets and parks.
🎭 Museum afternoons at places like the Archaeological Museum.
📷 Soft golden light for photographing the cathedral and Old Town lanes.
❄️ Snow around Nevsky Cathedral gives the city a fairytale look.
🔥 Warm taverns serving hearty soups and grilled meats.
🎄 Christmas market stalls in the center during December.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use the metro to reach main areas quickly; Serdika is the central hub.
🚍 Trams and buses cover neighborhoods not along the metro line.
🚶 The historic center is very walkable.
🎟️ Day passes are handy if you plan multiple rides.

city_events.name: Sofia Summer Fest
city_events.description: Open-air concerts, films and cultural evenings across central parks and boulevards.

city_events.name: Christmas Market Sofia
city_events.description: Festive lights, traditional snacks, mulled wine and holiday atmosphere in the city center.

cities.name: Plovdiv
interests: Ancient History & Roman Theatre 🏛️ — Layers of Thracian, Roman and medieval heritage.
Old Town Atmosphere & Art 🎨 — Revival-era houses, museums and cobblestone lanes.
Creative District Life ☕ — Indie cafés, street art and youthful, boho vibes.
cities.local_food_tip: Try kebapche, mixed grill, banitsa and local sweets like baklava. Great places include Pavaj, Smokini and Rahat Tepe on the hill with epic sunset views.
cities.full_day: Morning: Start at the Ancient Roman Theatre, one of the best-preserved in the world, still used for concerts with views of the Rhodope Mountains. → Walk into Plovdiv Old Town to explore colorfully painted revival houses, small museums and artisan shops. Afternoon: Head down toward the lively Kapana Creative District, full of murals, cafés, design boutiques and open-air seating. → Have lunch in Kapana and enjoy its youthful atmosphere. → Visit the Ethnographic Museum. Late Afternoon: Climb up Nebet Tepe for panoramic city views and golden-hour photography. Night: Return toward Kapana for drinks, live music or relaxed evening walks.

ideas: 🌼 Perfect weather for exploring Old Town and its museums.
🎨 Street art walks and café hopping in the Kapana District.
🎶 Open-air shows at the Roman Theatre.
🍺 Evening energy in Kapana’s cafés and bars.
🍂 Golden tones around Old Town houses.
📸 Soft light from Nebet Tepe for sunset panoramas.
🔥 Cozy taverns in Old Town serving hearty Bulgarian dishes.
🏛️ Museums and galleries ideal for cold days.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Local buses efficiently connect neighborhoods.
🚶 Old Town and Kapana are best explored on foot.
🚕 Taxis are affordable for short distances.

city_events.name: Kapana Fest
city_events.description: Street art, music and food stalls take over the creative district.

city_events.name: Plovdiv Autumn Arts Week
city_events.description: Exhibitions and artistic events around Old Town and Kapana.

cities.name: Varna
interests: Beach & Black Sea Coast 🌊 — Sandy beaches, calm waters and relaxed seaside culture.
Maritime History & Museums ⚓ — Naval exhibits, archaeological treasures and seafront monuments.
Nightlife & Seaside Walks 🌃 — Bars, promenades and lively summer energy.
cities.local_food_tip: Enjoy fresh fish, seafood, tarator and coastal dishes by the sea. Try The Sea Terrace, Staria Chinar and Happy Sea Garden for reliable meals.
cities.full_day: Morning: Walk the long paths of Sea Garden, a huge park with monuments, playgrounds and sea viewpoints. → Stop for coffee near the promenade. Afternoon: Relax at Varna Beach or head north to Golden Sands for more spacious sandy areas. → Visit the Archaeological Museum to see the world’s oldest processed gold. Late Afternoon: Explore the Naval Museum or walk along the lighthouse pier for breeze and views. Night: Enjoy seaside dinners or cocktails along the waterfront.

ideas: 🌿 Long walks through Sea Garden with early flowers.
📷 Great lighting for Black Sea photos and relaxed promenades.
🏖️ Swimming, sunbathing and evening walks along Varna Beach.
🎶 Outdoor bars and summer nightlife near the coast.
🍁 Softer sunlight over the Black Sea.
🍲 Warm seafood meals in coastal restaurants.
🌊 Peaceful empty beaches and dramatic sea scenery.
🔥 Cozy cafés around the city center.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Buses and trolleybuses connect the Sea Garden and beaches.
🚶 Promenades are best done on foot.
🚕 Taxis convenient for reaching distant resorts like Golden Sands.

city_events.name: Varna Summer Festival
city_events.description: Classical concerts, dance performances and arts events across the city.

city_events.name: Seaside Nights Varna
city_events.description: Beach parties, live music and summer nightlife.

cities.name: Veliko Tarnovo
interests: Medieval History & Fortresses 🏰 — Former imperial capital with dramatic landscapes.
Old Town Charm & Photography 📸 — River cliffs, narrow streets and wooden houses.
Nature & Hilltop Walks 🌿 — Scenic hikes, river bends and sunset viewpoints.
cities.local_food_tip: Try grilled meats, banitsa, hearty soups and local cheeses — best enjoyed in traditional Old Town inns like Hadji Nikoli Inn, hilltop Rahat Tepe or riverside Restaurant Ego.
cities.full_day: Morning: Start at the majestic Tsarevets Fortress, walking through medieval gates, towers and viewpoints overlooking the Yantra River cliffs. → Continue to Trapezitsa Hill, another historical ridge with ruins and panoramas. Afternoon: Explore Samovodska Charshiya, a street of artisan workshops and craft boutiques. → Have lunch in a traditional inn. Late Afternoon: Walk along Gurko Street, one of the most photogenic areas with river-side houses. → Take sunset photos from Stambolov Bridge. Night: Enjoy dinner with river views and a calm night walk in the illuminated old quarter.

ideas: 🌿 Green valleys and fresh breezes around Tsarevets.
📷 Great contrast between cliffs and spring colors.
🎆 Visiting evening shows at Tsarevets during festivals.
🌌 Warm nights ideal for riverside walks.
🍁 Hills around the Yantra glowing with autumn colors.
🥘 Cozy meals in traditional inns after hilltop walks.
❄️ Snowy rooftops and a calm medieval atmosphere.
🔥 Warming soups and local food in rustic restaurants.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Intercity buses connect VT with Sofia, Varna and Plovdiv.
🚶 Old Town and Tsarevets are best explored on foot.
🚕 Taxis help with steep climbs.

city_events.name: Tsarevets Sound & Light Show
city_events.description: Evening light and sound projections illuminate the fortress walls.

city_events.name: Autumn Wine & Culture Week
city_events.description: Wine tastings, performances and craft events through Old Town.

cities.name: Bansko
interests: Mountain Nature & Hiking ⛰️ — Alpine lakes, forests and fresh air in the Pirin Mountains.
Ski & Winter Sports 🎿 — One of Bulgaria’s most popular winter resorts with modern facilities.
Traditional Village Life 🏡 — Stone houses, wooden balconies and charming old-town lanes.
cities.local_food_tip: Try kachamak, hearty stews, grilled meats, bean soups and homemade bread — warming mountain cuisine. Great local taverns include Mehana Dedo Pene, Baryakova Mehana and Momini Dvori.
cities.full_day: Morning: Start your day in Old Town, walking through narrow stone-paved streets lined with traditional houses and small shops. → Visit the Holy Trinity Church, known for its distinctive bell tower and peaceful courtyard. → Stop for a warm drink in a cozy café before heading up the mountain. Afternoon: Take the Bansko Gondola to reach the ski area or hiking zones. Enjoy panoramic views and choose between skiing, snowboarding or scenic walks depending on season. → Have lunch at a mountain hut or slope-side restaurant. Late Afternoon: Explore forest trails, lakes and lookout spots around the Pirin foothills. In summer, shorter hikes lead to crystal-clear lakes; in winter, visitors enjoy snowy landscapes and sunset views from upper slopes. Night: Return to town for a traditional dinner with live Balkan music, then wander through the calm evening streets lit by lantern-style lamps.

ideas: 🌼 Easy-to-moderate hikes around Pirin foothills as snow melts.
📸 Fresh greenery around Old Town Bansko streets.
⛰️ Full-day hikes to lakes and viewpoints inside Pirin National Park.
🌌 Starry nights in quiet mountain areas.
🍁 Golden forests around mid-altitude trails.
🥘 Cozy tavern meals after cool-weather walks.
🎿 Skiing and snowboarding in the main area above town.
🔥 Warm dinners with traditional dishes after snowy days.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Buses from Sofia go directly to Bansko.
🚶 The town is compact and walkable.
🚡 Gondola is the fastest way into the mountains.

city_events.name: Bansko Jazz Festival
city_events.description: Outdoor concerts and musical performances drawing visitors from across Bulgaria.

city_events.name: Winter Ski Opening
city_events.description: Kickoff of the ski season with events, music and winter celebrations.

cities.name: Burgas
interests: Black Sea Coast & Beaches 🌊 — Long sandy beaches and peaceful sea views.
Lakes & Nature 🌿 — Wetlands, birdwatching and nature reserves around the city.
Promenades & Urban Parks 🌳 — Seaside paths, gardens and charming squares.
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh Black Sea fish, mussels, tarator, salads and light summer dishes dominate Burgas cuisine. Top places include Neptun, Happy Bar & Grill and seaside cafés near the pier.
cities.full_day: Morning: Start with a walk through the green lanes of Sea Garden, a spacious park stretching along the coastline. → Visit the open-air terraces and viewpoints overlooking the Black Sea. Afternoon: Relax at Burgas Beach or take a short bus/taxi to Atanasovsko Lake, known for birdwatching and pink flamingos. → Have lunch at a beachside restaurant. Late Afternoon: Explore the central pedestrian zone around Alexandrovska Street. → Enjoy coffee or ice cream in the shade. Night: Walk along the pier at sunset and dine at a waterfront restaurant.

ideas: 🌼 Relaxed walks in Sea Garden as flowers bloom.
🐦 Birdwatching around Atanasovsko Lake.
🏖️ Swimming, sunbathing and lively beach bars.
🌅 Golden sunsets from Burgas Pier.
🍁 Cooler seaside walks ideal for photography.
🥘 Enjoy warm seafood meals with fewer crowds.
🌊 Stark and beautiful winter landscapes along the coast.
🔥 Warm cafés and quiet city evenings.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Buses connect Burgas with nearby coastal areas.
🚶 The center and Sea Garden are walkable.
🚕 Taxis are convenient for lakes and distant beaches.

city_events.name: Burgas Sand Sculpture Festival
city_events.description: Large artistic sand sculptures displayed near the Sea Garden.

city_events.name: Burgas Seafood Festival
city_events.description: Food stalls and tasting events focused on fresh Black Sea cuisine.

cities.name: Ruse
interests: Danube River Views 🌊 — Riverside walks and wide open horizons.
Neo-Baroque Architecture 🏛️ — Elegant buildings earning Ruse the nickname 'Little Vienna'.
Museums & Culture 🎭 — History, art and preserved urban heritage.
cities.local_food_tip: Try grilled river fish, traditional soups, salads and pastries. Nice dining options include Happy Ruse, Pontoon Restaurant on the river and small local taverns near the central square.
cities.full_day: Morning: Begin at Freedom Square, surrounded by elegant 19th-century buildings and leafy promenades. → Visit the Regional Historical Museum. Afternoon: Walk toward the riverbank and relax along the Danube promenade, enjoying open views and breezy walkways. → Have lunch at a riverside restaurant. Late Afternoon: Explore the architectural streets around the center, with beautifully decorated façades and cafés. → Stop in small galleries or shops. Night: Watch sunset along the Danube, then return to the center for dinner or evening drinks.

ideas: 🌿 Riverside walks along the promenade.
📷 Soft colors over the Danube’s wide horizon.
🌅 Sunset views and outdoor dining by the river.
🎶 Occasional concerts and events in central squares.
🍁 Warm tones on elegant façades around Freedom Square.
🏛️ Museum visits in cooler weather.
🌊 Peaceful river scenery.
🔥 Cozy cafés in the historic center.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Buses cover most areas including the riverbank.
🚶 The city center is walkable and compact.
🚗 Car is useful for visiting nature areas near the Danube.

city_events.name: Ruse Carnival
city_events.description: Parades, music and lively celebrations in the center.

city_events.name: Danube River Festival
city_events.description: Cultural, music and food events celebrating the riverside atmosphere.

cities.name: Nesebar
interests: UNESCO Old Town 🏛️ — Ancient churches and medieval architecture on a small peninsula.
Sea Views & Coastal Walks 🌊 — Charming seaside scenery and gentle promenades.
History & Archaeology 🏺 — Roman, Byzantine and Bulgarian treasures.
cities.local_food_tip: Expect seafood, grilled fish, tarator, salads and homemade desserts. Great choices include Kristian, White Rose and eateries lining the Old Town coast.
cities.full_day: Morning: Enter Nesebar Old Town via the causeway bridge, enjoying early morning light over the sea. → Explore the Church of St. Stephen and Christ Pantocrator Church. Afternoon: Walk the narrow lanes filled with wooden houses, craft shops and cafés. → Have lunch at a sea-view restaurant. Late Afternoon: Visit small museums and archaeological remains scattered around the town. → Relax near the coastline with breezy sea views. Night: Watch sunset over the Black Sea and enjoy dinner surrounded by medieval walls and sea breeze.

ideas: 🌼 Peaceful streets before summer crowds.
📸 Crisp morning photos around ancient churches.
🏖️ Perfect for beach trips combined with Old Town sightseeing.
🌅 Long sunset walks by the sea.
🍁 Quieter alleys ideal for photography.
🍲 Warm seafood on breezy evenings.
❄️ Very quiet atmosphere for historical exploration.
🔥 Cozy taverns open during the colder months.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Buses connect Nesebar with Sunny Beach and Burgas.
🚶 Old Town is fully walkable.
🚕 Taxis helpful for reaching distant beach areas.

city_events.name: Nesebar International Folklore Festival
city_events.description: Music, dance and cultural programs in the Old Town.

city_events.name: Sea & Heritage Week
city_events.description: Events celebrating Nesebar’s maritime and historical traditions.

cities.name: Stara Zagora
interests: History & Roman Ruins 🏛️ — Ancient streets, walls and archaeological sites.
Parks & Lakes 🌳 — Relaxed green areas and family-friendly paths.
City Culture & Cafés ☕ — A balanced mix of historic and modern Bulgarian life.
cities.local_food_tip: Try grilled meats, hearty soups, fresh salads and pastries. Recommended spots include Uniqato, Shtastlivetsa and various taverns around the pedestrian center.
cities.full_day: Morning: Visit the Regional History Museum and the Roman Augusta Traiana ruins nearby. → Walk through pedestrian streets and stop for coffee. Afternoon: Explore parks like Ayazmo Park, offering viewpoints and long forest paths. → Have lunch in the center. Late Afternoon: Visit small galleries, shops and squares. → Relax by Lake Zagorka. Night: Enjoy dinner in one of the modern restaurants, then stroll through the illuminated pedestrian zone.

ideas: 🌸 Fresh greenery in Ayazmo Park.
🏛️ Comfortable weather for exploring Roman ruins.
🌳 Afternoon shade in parks.
🌃 Lively evenings in the city center.
🍁 Beautiful fall foliage around Lake Zagorka.
🥘 Warm meals after chilly walks.
❄️ Quiet archaeological sites in winter scenery.
🔥 Cozy cafés around the pedestrian zones.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Buses serve all major districts.
🚶 The center is easy to explore on foot.
🚗 A car helps for reaching Ayazmo Park’s upper areas.

city_events.name: Stara Zagora Festival of Arts
city_events.description: Concerts, theater and cultural events across the city.

city_events.name: Autumn Wine Days
city_events.description: Wine tastings and local cuisine festivities around the center.
